questions.q: Explain why a plant kept in the dark for two days loses mass. (3)
questions.a: No photosynthesis (1); it still respires (1), using stored glucose and starch (1)

questions.q: Explain why almost all food chains depend on photosynthesis. (3)
questions.a: Producers make glucose (1); energy stored passes to consumers when eaten (1); without producers no energy enters the chain (1)

questions.q: Explain why photosynthesis is described as endothermic. (2)
questions.a: It takes in energy (1) from light, which is stored as chemical energy in glucose (1)
questions.model: Two marks, two points: energy taken in (endothermic); where it goes (chemical store in glucose). Write both.

questions.q: Why is starch, not glucose, stored? (1)
questions.a: Starch is insoluble so does not affect osmosis (and is compact)
